has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

target.description: Exact gene/chromosome, e.g. MYC, MYCN, TP53, isochromosome 17q, chromosome 8, 10 or 11. Keep MYC and MYCN separate.
target.title: Target

alteration.description: Amplification, gain, loss, mutation or isochromosome as stated. Amplification and gain are distinct; preserve the reported term.
alteration.title: Alteration

status.description: ABSENT requires explicitly negative testing; silence is NOT_DOCUMENTED.

origin.description: Somatic, germline or unknown as documented; never infer germline from tumor-only testing.
origin.title: Origin

report_date.description: Date of the source result, ISO date at supported precision.
report_date.title: Report Date

report_date_precision.description: Precision for report_date; null if absent.

source_report.description: Documented source report identifier or title linking this alteration to its classification.
source_report.title: Source Report

testing_method.description: Method supporting this alteration, if stated.

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

molecular_group.description: Explicit medulloblastoma group. NON_WNT_NON_SHH does not distinguish Group 3 from 4. Preserve conflicting calls; never infer a group from a single alteration.

integrated_diagnosis_verbatim.description: Exact diagnosis/classification, including ETMR, pineoblastoma or revised non-embryonal diagnoses. ATRT can be an exclusion/reclassification finding.
integrated_diagnosis_verbatim.title: Integrated Diagnosis Verbatim

methylation_class.description: Exact methylation class/subclass, including SHH-I/II or Group 3 subtype if reported.
methylation_class.title: Methylation Class

calibrated_score.description: Explicit classifier score on a 0–1 scale; do not invent a confidence threshold.
calibrated_score.title: Calibrated Score

methods.description: Methods documented for this result. A note quoting a group without the original method is CLINICAL_SUMMARY.
methods.title: Methods

report_date.description: Date of this molecular report, ISO date at supported precision; distinct from original diagnosis.
report_date.title: Report Date

report_date_precision.description: Precision for report_date; null if absent.

source_report.description: Report identifier, laboratory or referenced report title as documented; do not invent identifiers.
source_report.title: Source Report

specimen.description: Tumor, blood or other specimen as documented.
specimen.title: Specimen

review_context.description: Local, central, retrospective or revised review, only if documented.
review_context.title: Review Context

uncertainty.description: Explicit uncertainty, insufficient tissue, failed testing or conflicting classifications. Null if not stated.
uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

reports.description: One entry per report/classification; retain conflicting reports separately.
reports.title: Reports

alterations.description: Documented alterations or explicit negative results; empty is not a negative panel.
alterations.title: Alterations
